full_prompt_en: A square fantasy landscape painting shows an old stone complex perched along the rim of a sheer gorge, with a narrow waterfall dropping from beneath it into mist. The viewpoint faces the cliff from across an unseen gap. Warm ocher towers and connected buildings cluster along the upper left and center, their irregular roofs stepping down toward the right. A tall square tower rises at the far left behind a lower hall with deep window openings and dark timber projections. Smaller arches and balconies cling to the rock below, partly hidden by green shrubs. The stone appears worn and patched, with orange sunlit faces and cool brown crevices. A white waterfall begins just below the main building and falls nearly straight through the center-left, its bright vertical sheet splitting into a few thin strands as it drops. The dark cliff walls run down beyond the lower edge, marked by long vertical fissures, damp streaks, and pockets of moss. At the very bottom left, a narrow sunlit ledge carries yellow-green ground cover across the dark foreground. Behind the complex, dense leafy trees blend into pale green and blue atmospheric layers. The right half opens to an enormous misty void, with a faint distant rock face barely visible through cool gray-blue haze. Light comes softly from the upper left, giving the high stonework a golden warmth while leaving the waterfall gorge in shadow and diffused moisture. The painting is detailed where the buildings and cliff meet, with small strokes describing stone, wood, leaves, and broken edges; the far background dissolves into broad soft washes. Warm masonry, cold gray rock, bright white water, and airy blue distance form the main color relationships. The composition sets concentrated habitation high on a rugged edge against a vast empty drop, making the place feel ancient, precarious, and quiet.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻风景画描绘一组旧石建筑沿陡峭峡谷边缘高踞，一道窄瀑布从其下落进雾里。视点从看不见的对岸面向悬崖。暖赭色塔与相连建筑聚在左上和中央，不规则屋顶朝右逐渐降低。最左一座高方塔立在较低厅堂后，厅堂有深窗洞与暗木挑檐。更小的拱廊和阳台贴着下方岩壁，部分被绿灌木遮住。石面显得磨旧而有修补，受光面橙暖，裂隙冷棕。白瀑布从主体建筑下方开始，在中心偏左几乎直落，明亮水幕下降时分出几缕细线。暗崖壁垂出下画边，有长竖裂、湿痕与苔藓小块。最左下，一条受光窄岩台在暗前景上托着黄绿色地表植物。建筑后面，浓叶树与浅绿、蓝色空气层相融。右半幅打开巨大的雾中空域，一面遥远石壁在冷灰蓝雾里几乎看不见。光从左上柔和而来，给高处石建筑金暖色，让瀑布峡谷留在阴影和扩散水汽里。建筑与岩壁交界处绘画细密，小笔触描述石、木、叶和破损边缘；远背景则溶成宽阔柔刷水洗。暖石、冷灰岩、亮白水与空气蓝远方形成主要色彩关系。构图把集中人造形态放在崎岖高边，对着广阔空落，使这个地方显得古老、险峻而安静。
style_prompt_en: Painterly illustration combines densely worked warm surfaces with a broad cool atmospheric opening. Ocher and muted orange catch upper directional light, while charcoal brown and slate blue deepen vertical recesses. Fine chipped edges, small repeated marks, and organic interruptions make near masses tactile; distant forms lose detail in translucent gray-blue haze. A slim bright vertical accent cuts through heavy dark planes and supplies a clear visual hinge. Concentrated forms on one side are balanced by a much larger empty area on the other, creating dramatic scale without crowding the frame. Soft light and moisture-like diffusion bridge the sharp near texture and disappearing background. The overall rhythm alternates stepped horizontal layers, deep vertical lines, and spacious silence.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式插画把细密加工的暖色表面与宽阔冷色空气开口结合。赭色与低调橙色接住上方定向光，炭棕与石板蓝加深竖向凹处。细小剥落边、重复笔迹和有机打断让近处大块可触；远形在半透明灰蓝雾里失去细节。一道细亮竖向重点切过沉重暗平面，成为清楚视觉转轴。一侧集中的形态由另一侧大得多的空域平衡，形成戏剧性尺度却不挤满画框。柔光与水汽般扩散连接近处锐利纹理和渐隐背景。整体节奏在阶梯状横层、深竖线和宽敞寂静之间交替。
theme_en: An old stone complex perched above a waterfall and misty gorge
theme_zh: 一组旧石建筑高踞在瀑布与雾峡之上
name: Didier Graffet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
